Method of Attack: Ransomware attacks using remote human operators with existing Domain Admin credentials to spread across enterprise networks
Threaded encryption process for quicker operation
Using previously stolen privileged credentials to destroy or hold data for ransom
Attack Vector: Use of stolen Domain Admin credentials
Brute-force attacks on Remote Desktop servers accessible from the Internet
Socially-engineered attacks such as phishing and malware downloads
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom demand of 565 bitcoins ($4.9 million) in PEMEX attack
Large code overlap between BitPaymer and DoppelPaymer
Victims identified in June and July 2019
